context: Write a short decision record only. Inventory counts from the live registries. Do not change runtime code, registries, or support_status values in this item.
description:
DECISION GATE for the architecture-simplification program (origin/develop 29380ce9e).

Problem: 51 platforms (5 stable / 28 beta / 17 experimental / 1 deprecated) and 23 benchmark families have no recorded usage, demand, or support-cost evidence. Later steps (SQL-primitive fold, family-seam pilot, package extraction) guess at breadth.

This item records a product judgment. It does not delete code.

Options (pick exactly one and write it to _project/decisions/):
A) Commit to carry all current registry entries; experimental stays labeled and in-tree.
B) Commit to stable+beta as the supported product; experimental/deprecated stay in-tree but surface:internal or extra-gated after a later measured item.
C) Explicit deferral: name the evidence that would settle A vs B (install-size, import time, CI minutes, demand). Until that evidence exists, no family/platform deletion and no companion-package extraction.

Stop condition: a decision file exists that names the committed tiers OR an explicit deferral with evidence criteria. docs/design/future-state/index.md must cite that file (handled in arch-future-state-index-reconciliation).

Out of scope: deleting benchmarks/platforms; creating benchbox-experimental or benchbox-maintainer distributions; MCP production publication.
